## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
CAUTION regime. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Mixed signals and major megacap divergences (MSFT, NVDA, META showing 1W weakness vs 1M strength) plus sector mix (Tech and Energy positive while Financials and Healthcare lag) justify caution; Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Energy leads: MPC (1W: +10.90% | 1M: +6.85%) ABOVE TREND and XOM (1W: +2.85% | 1M: -5.22%) RECOVERY; Technology strong: GOOGL (1W: +10.29% | 1M: +28.59%) ABOVE TREND and INTC (1W: +28.72% | 1M: +114.24%) ABOVE TREND. Sector breadth: Energy, Technology, Utilities showing the clearest 1W strength.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Healthcare weak: ABT (1W: -7.24% | 1M: -14.36%) BELOW TREND and SYK (1W: -8.32% | 1M: -11.32%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary weak: LOW (1W: -6.09% | 1M: -3.58%) BELOW TREND and SHOP (1W: -10.81% | 1M: -8.37%) BELOW TREND. Communication showing stress via CHTR (1W: -8.05% | 1M: -27.64%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: INTC (1W: +28.72% | 1M: +114.24%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +21.62% | 1M: +45.10%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +13.02% | 1M: +6.55%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +10.90% | 1M: +6.85%) ABOVE TREND, GD (1W: +10.65% | 1M: -0.76%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: SHOP (1W: -10.81% | 1M: -8.37%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: -10.41% | 1M: +4.97%) CORRECTION, SYK (1W: -8.32% | 1M: -11.32%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -8.05% | 1M: -27.64%) BELOW TREND, LOW (1W: -6.09% | 1M: -3.58%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in select high-multiple and consumer names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Top 1W movers: INTC (1W: +28.72%), QCOM (1W: +21.62%), LLY (1W: +13.02%) — strong short-term follow-through. Major divergence: multiple megacaps (MSFT (1W: -4.60% | 1M: +9.83%) CORRECTION, NVDA (1W: -7.33% | 1M: +11.20%) CORRECTION, META CORRECTION) create a MAJOR DIVERGENCE — watch for trend breaks and don’t overstate regime conviction.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed, momentum but volatile: GOOGL (1W: +10.29% | 1M: +28.59%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +10.51% | 1M: +26.46%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +9.66% | 1M: +60.97%) ABOVE TREND versus NVDA (1W: -7.33% | 1M: +11.20%) CORRECTION and META (1W: -10.41% | 1M: +4.97%) CORRECTION. Sector 1W: +4.11% (24 stocks) — internal rotation within Tech.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials mixed to soft on the week: V (1W: +3.81% | 1M: +5.86%) ABOVE TREND while JPM (1W: -0.70% | 1M: +4.67%) CORRECTION and MA (1W: -2.03% | 1M: -0.66%) BELOW TREND. Sector 1W: -0.17% (20 stocks) — trend signals uneven, watch bank/processor divergence.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare lagging on the week: LLY (1W: +13.02% | 1M: +6.55%) ABOVE TREND is the clear outperformer while ABT (1W: -7.24% | 1M: -14.36%) BELOW TREND and PFE (1W: -1.30% | 1M: -6.09%) BELOW TREND show weakness. Sector 1W: -0.94% (17 stocks) — selective opportunities around news catalysts.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor selective exposure to names showing confirmed above-trend follow-through (INTC (1W: +28.72% | 1M: +114.24%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +21.62% | 1M: +45.10%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +13.02% | 1M: +6.55%) ABOVE TREND) and cyclical movers (CAT (1W: +10.04% | 1M: +25.02%) ABOVE TREND, MPC ABOVE TREND). Reduce exposure to high-multiple names under CORRECTION (NVDA (1W: -7.33% | 1M: +11.20%) CORRECTION, META (1W: -10.41% | 1M: +4.97%) CORRECTION) and be selective given the MAJOR DIVERGENCE.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +28.72% | 1M: +114.24%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +21.62% | 1M: +45.10%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +13.02% | 1M: +6.55%) ABOVE TREND — watch follow-through. BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -7.33% | 1M: +11.20%) CORRECTION, META (1W: -10.41% | 1M: +4.97%) CORRECTION, SHOP (1W: -10.81% | 1M: -8.37%) BELOW TREND — monitor momentum fade.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Technology and Energy if 1W leaders sustain gains (Tech 1W: +4.11%, Energy 1W: +4.44%). BEARISH: Healthcare and Consumer Discretionary remain vulnerable (Healthcare 1W: -0.94%, Consumer Disc. 1W: -0.92%) — watch news flow.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
Watch NVDA (1W: -7.33% | 1M: +11.20%) CORRECTION for a clean weekly reversal to negate CORRECTION status; GOOGL (1W: +10.29% | 1M: +28.59%) ABOVE TREND needs follow-through to confirm leadership; INTC (1W: +28.72% | 1M: +114.24%) ABOVE TREND requires continued volume to validate a sustained regime shift. Monitor ABT (1W: -7.24% | 1M: -14.36%) BELOW TREND for sentiment-driven reversal.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
ABT (+75): ABT (1W: -7.24% | 1M: -14.36%) BELOW TREND — FDA clearance headline; price diverging from very bullish news, watch for catch-up if confirmation. (Only ABT among the top bullish headlines has clear SP100 price data in today’s feed.)

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
SHOP (-65): SHOP (1W: -10.81% | 1M: -8.37%) BELOW TREND — Q1 loss and cautious guidance; price confirms bearish news. META (-50): META (1W: -10.41% | 1M: +4.97%) CORRECTION — regulatory headlines align with 1W weakness, watch for further distribution. CHTR (-50): CHTR (1W: -8.05% | 1M: -27.64%) BELOW TREND — headline and price both negative.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION regime; Style: mixed (no clear Growth vs Value leadership). INTC (1W: +28.72% | 1M: +114.24%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +21.62% | 1M: +45.10%) ABOVE TREND and LLY (1W: +13.02% | 1M: +6.55%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: MAJOR DIVERGENCE among megacaps (MSFT, NVDA, META in CORRECTION) and sentiment-price divergence in ABT (+75) — monitor for trend confirmation.
